description: 부산광역시_과거 산사태 정보 [landslides and debris flows] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 부산광역시. 부산광역시에서 과거 발생한 산사태 피해 현황을 제공하는 데이터로, 발생연도, 산사태재해명, 시군구명, 법정동·읍면동명 및 산사태 피해면적 등의 정보를 제공. Coverage: 부산광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 부산광역시. Its tags are 부산, 재난안전, 산사태정보, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
